answer: Proof of Stake provides a robust oasis for AI consensus by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral. This lotus of staked assets forces an attacker to incur prohibitive financial costs to influence the network, as expanding one's identity requires acquiring majority control of the total supply. Scaling beyond the current security horizon becomes economically irrational, as Sybil attacks result in the immediate forfeiture of the attacker's own capital, ensuring network integrity through direct fiscal disincentives.
